title: Reverse a sort that other modules rely on
measures: Shows the newest orders first on the paginated history page without flipping the shared store order that store credit (pays the oldest unpaid order first) and the buy-again box (takes the last order) silently depend on.
prompt: Customers complain that their order history starts with orders from years ago. Show the newest orders first in the order history.

commits.message: feat(orders): order history, store credit, buy again
